summary: Fresenius Medical Care AG filed a Form 6-K containing its Q1 2026 interim report, which discloses ongoing share buyback programs. The filing references two tranches: Tranche One active from August 2025 to November 2025, and Tranche Two active from January 2026 to February 2026. No specific price per share, premium, or shareholder vote is mentioned; the buyback is authorized and executed on the open market. The company reduces outstanding shares, returning capital to shareholders. No advisors are named. The mechanical structure is a standard open-market repurchase. What to watch: continuation of buyback pace and any renewal or expansion of the program. Risk-arb angle: minimal; buybacks are accretive but not event-driven.
